implementation: Default Compose graph starts PostgreSQL 18, waits for its healthcheck, applies Alembic once, then starts a four-worker Uvicorn API and independent alpha/beta fake providers from the shared image.
API startup depends on healthy PostgreSQL, successful migration completion, and healthy alpha/beta providers. API and both provider processes have healthchecks.
The test profile provisions its own PostgreSQL 18 database and volume, runs a separate Alembic migration, and gates the pytest runner on successful migration.

Integration fixtures default to integer_generator_test and reject any DATABASE_URL whose database path differs. Compose contract tests parse the YAML into typed Pydantic models and assert the startup graph, four workers, isolated test DATABASE_URLs, healthchecks, profiles, and absence of container_name.
The Docker image includes Alembic files, tests, and compose.yaml; .dockerignore no longer excludes tests. PyYAML stubs are a locked dev dependency for the typed YAML contract test.

database_isolation.url_validation: tests/conftest.py asserts urlsplit(DATABASE_URL).path.removeprefix('/') == 'integer_generator_test' before creating the engine.
